config_resolution.resolution_rule: Clean roles read only this sanitized root, their own role config, own role state/feedback and public sources. Non-exploration roles resolve DOWNSTREAM_STATE. control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup, fetch this root and the own role config at that exact SHA, repeat SHA-only lookup before semantic work, then freeze.

chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.use_only_when: a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup is not exposed in the scheduled Chat connector
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_1: fetch every role-approved authoritative path and record the exact returned Git blob SHA plus parsed revision; consume no other semantic input
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_2: immediately before the first role-local/public semantic read, fetch the same authoritative paths again in the same order
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.valid_when: all path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references are identical, no forbidden semantic input was consumed, and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.freeze: freeze the verified path/blob/revision tuple for the invocation and record transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.post_freeze: unrelated main movement is not a stop; later checks may compare only the frozen authoritative paths/blobs
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.failure: write diagnostic checkpoint and exact continuation, keep the recurring task enabled, and retry next invocation; never self-disable
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.aba_guard: monotonic control/config revisions and cross-file control references must agree; rollback or mismatch is fail-closed

control_freshness.postfreeze_rule: After the semantic-freeze barrier, unrelated main movement is not a stop when every frozen authoritative blob remains unchanged and no own-state conflict exists. Later transport checks compare only frozen authority paths/blobs and consume no newer-head semantic content.
control_freshness.write_rule: Role-local writes remain current-blob/CAS/readback guarded; authority mismatch is diagnostic-only.

clean_receipt_provenance_contract.required: Every CLEAN receipt/checkpoint reports exact frozen root path/blob/parsed revision, own config path/blob/parsed revision, transport mode, phase/root/task, bootstrap_valid and exact continuation.
clean_receipt_provenance_contract.valid: bootstrap_valid=true only when authority identities are verified by preferred or approved fallback bootstrap.
clean_receipt_provenance_contract.invalid: Mismatch, unverifiable identity or invented revision is diagnostic-only and cannot count as Phase-1 evidence.
clean_receipt_provenance_contract.cleanliness: Authority verification never authorizes reading other roles, downstream/O state, shared ledger, commit messages, diffs or newer-head semantics.

recurring_scheduler_persistence.rule: While enabled_desired=true, invocation end, checkpoint, no result, runtime boundary, missing SHA-only ref or blocker never changes the recurring enabled state.
recurring_scheduler_persistence.blocked_run: Persist global_completion=false, exact blocker and continuation, then retry.
recurring_scheduler_persistence.controller_only: Only the authorized optimizer may perform re-enable-only reconciliation after repairing a concrete cause; workers never change physical scheduler state.

semantic_inputs_allowed: own Phase-1 assignment from this root or own config
semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
commit messages/diffs/unrelated semantic payload exposed only during transport authority lookup
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: Own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local QC only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge or other-worker information.
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale or cross-role reads.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
clean_exploration_boundary.write_boundary: Only role-local state/output and immutable own receipt destinations named by the own role config, with CAS/readback.
clean_exploration_boundary.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected state; never direct-merge main; never claim Work-only capability.
